_format.what: One entry per agent, keyed by the agent's page slug (allocator = Allie, the Chief Allocator). A licensed model is used only when every required field is present and both files exist in this directory; without one the agent page shows a name card labelled 3D PORTRAIT PENDING. Every agent has its own model: no entry may point at another agent's model file.

required.model: file name of a glTF 2.0 binary (.glb) in this directory: one skinned humanoid (Mixamo or VRM/humanoid bone names, or map them in 'bones'), ARKit 52 face blendshapes (or map them in 'blendshapes'); Meshopt compression allowed; textures PNG/JPEG/WebP inside the .glb (KTX2 is not supported in this build)
required.license_file: file name, in this directory, of the licence text shipped with the model
required.license_spdx: the licence identifier (SPDX, or LicenseRef-<vendor> for a commercial licence)
required.licensed_from: who granted the licence (vendor, artist, or contract reference)
required.test_asset: must be false: a test asset is never shown as a character

optional.yaw: radians to turn the model to face the camera
optional.bones: role -> exact bone name, for rigs outside the built-in Mixamo/VRM table
optional.blendshapes: ARKit name -> exact morph target name, for faces outside the ARKit naming
optional.candidate_label: shown on the stage while the model is under evaluation (the placeholder tag is replaced by it, never hidden)
optional.credit: the attribution line shown in the page footer
optional.hide_materials: material names to hide (e.g. alpha-card hair whose opacity map the vendor did not supply)
optional.arms_down: false to keep the model's bind pose (default: a T/A pose is turned arms-down)
optional.source: where the model came from: repository, path of the source files, the converter, and the sha256 of the shipped .glb
optional.casting: why this asset was chosen for the agent, and its known gaps against the brief

derek.credit: Character model: Microsoft Rocketbox Business_Male_03 (MIT, © 2020 Microsoft)

source.converted_by: FBX2glTF 0.9.7 + gltf-transform (tools/rocketbox_to_glb.mjs, tools/rocketbox_textures.py): head colour 2K JPEG, body colour and every normal/roughness map 1K JPEG, hair-card/lash opacity map 1K RGBA PNG, specular mapped to roughness; the 175 FBX morph targets order-verified against the FBX, then pruned to the 67 the pipeline drives (15 visemes AA_VI_*, ARKit 52 AK_*); Meshopt-compressed

derek.casting: adult man in a charcoal two-piece suit, white shirt and teal tie: the analytical finance/technology professional
known_gaps: Rocketbox is a real-time asset (about 10k triangles, 2K head texture): credible at chest framing on a phone, not photoreal in a close-up
no authored animation clips: idle, gestures and speech are procedural (cc_avatar.js)
